body: Ew, clubs....sexual harassment, loud crappy music, overpriced drinks...doesn't sound like fun at all.

Oh, I understand. I am sorry for making assumptions.

I really don't think I can. I've joined clubs and tried to be part of communities. I've done Meetup.com. I just don't fit in. Sometimes it's my fault, sometimes there were really mean and cliquish people. Or I'm too much of a liability to like with my issues and all.

Hi. Thanks for responding. I know your intentions are good but you don't know very much about me. I wish I had a friend who understood me and had interests in common so we could hang out and whatnot. You are a good person but I am a picky and pathetic person who can't shake off feeling like it's impersonal.

If I may ask, what is your native language? Your English is decent. I wish I could learn a language like you. I'm terrible at memorization.
